title: The Romance of the Coast
author: James Runciman

authorInfo.bio: James Runciman (1852–1891) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "The Romance of the Coast" by James Runciman is a novel likely written in the late 19th century. The book explores the lives of coastal communities, particularly focusing on the fishermen and their families, depicting their struggles, character, and the harsh realities of their environment.
